claims.summary: Scion-1.2 skips native Pass A skeleton generation for Local semester-sized courses (10+ lessons) and starts the proven prose course-map path immediately, while keeping native skeleton enabled for shorter local courses. The full local gauntlet passed at 99 average overall, 95.25 average texture, 0 P0/P1, $0, and 2242 seconds total, 26% faster than the 3044-second Scion-1.1 baseline.

Scion quality passes still blind-solve quiz keys, regenerate confirmed bad items, gate off-topic questions, and polish prose. Quiz-explanation polish skips only explanations that already meet the minimum length, causal-language, and keyed-option checks.

The Scion gauntlet now defaults to Scion-1.2, accepts the scion12 course alias, rejects stale local servers that do not advertise scion-1.2, writes reports under verification-output/scion-1.2-gauntlet, and records HTTP response failures in browser logs.
Local provider defaults, shim metadata, browser display names, stale storage migration, package scripts, and README instructions now point to Scion-1.2 while preserving keyless $0 generation.
The app version, package metadata, release manifest, latest-release surface, README, release contract, and Scion-1.2 roadmap all agree on v0.16.2.
